strategy.audience: busy home cooks who want restaurant-quality meals but believe authentic techniques require expensive ingredients and professional equipment.
strategy.core_insight: The secret to glossy, restaurant-quality pasta sauce is not expensive butter or heavy cream, but the starchy pasta water you normally throw down the drain.
strategy.reasoning: The curiosity gap hook immediately targets the hidden waste habit of draining pasta water without context, creating instant tension. The problem-agitate-solve structure then validates their current frustration with watery homemade sauce before revealing the pantry-staple fix.

hook_candidates.text: Stop pouring your pasta water down the sink immediately because that cloudy liquid is hiding the ultimate restaurant emulsion secret.
You are wasting the most valuable ingredient in your kitchen every single time you strain your pasta into the drain.
That starchy water you usually throw away is actually the missing link holding your homemade pasta sauce together like a pro.
